title: GLM-5.3 Flash NVFP4 — Prefill and Decode Capacity
description: GLM-5.3 Flash inference capacity on the Dell PowerEdge XE7740 across a three-repetition concurrency grid with Decode, Prefill, power, and fabric telemetry.

model.name: GLM-5.3 Flash
model.quantization: NVFP4 routed experts with higher-precision excluded modules

deployment.summary: 2 independent TP4 replicas behind HAProxy leastconn

host_fabric.link_idle: PCIe Gen1 x16 due to power management
host_fabric.link_under_load: PCIe Gen5 x16 on all eight GPUs

upi.reason: UPI PMUs exist but expose no named sysfs events; pinned Intel PCM detected four UPI ports/socket but could not acquire occupied/restricted PMUs. Destructive PCM -r was not used.

limitations: DCGM PCIe rates are GPU endpoint rates, not internal switch counters.
CUDA sample P2P output warns it is not a formal performance benchmark.
NCCL uses the pinned serving-image NCCL version and NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1.

notes: All 72 legacy run manifests are complete: Decode, Prefill, and Balanced across eight global-concurrency points with three repetitions each.
The comparable report independently selects Decode and Prefill; Balanced evidence remains in the authoritative raw campaign and legacy summary.
The request path was AIPerf through HAProxy leastconn to two independent TP4 vLLM replicas.
The legacy campaign did not preserve per-run HAProxy Prometheus snapshots, so HAProxy directional application-traffic panels remain unavailable rather than zero.
The legacy campaign predates process smaps_rollup collection, so process PSS/RSS attribution is unavailable.
CPU/NUMA affinity was not pinned; prior topology prose claiming pinning was inaccurate.
Raw campaign artifacts remain authoritative; no checksums are generated for this modern report bundle.

container.image: local/vllm-glm53-flash:sm120-v8 (local digest sha256:744e620fbed6c979937e64f69534dd64150334549c39b5f8e64da6f1c9ff9588; never pushed to a registry)
container.engine: vLLM (glm53-flash-x86_64-cu130 base) with marlin MoE backend and fp8_e4m3 KV cache
container.build: docker build -t local/vllm-glm53-flash:sm120-v8 image/ — a seven-stage chain flattened into the vendored Dockerfile. The ordered layers must not be merged or reordered: steps 3 and 4 exist only to repair dependency downgrades that step 2 causes. Every patch asserts its exact source line before replacing it, so a base-image change fails the build rather than silently producing an unpatched runtime.
container.caveats: The measured image was never pushed, so a rebuild will not reproduce the recorded digest. The RadixArk registry tags (radixark/vllm-glm53-flash:sm121-*) target SM121 and were built for the DGX Spark cluster, not this server — do not substitute them.

model.revision_note: NVFP4 routed experts with higher-precision excluded modules

reproducibility.topology: 2 independent TP4 replicas (GPUs 0-3 and 4-7 via CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES), ports 8080/8081, HAProxy leastconn in front; both measured series came from this single configuration

launch.profile: both replicas (decode and prefill share one deployment)
launch.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
MODEL_DIR="$HOME/models/LibertAIDAI--GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4--model"
ROOT="$HOME/benchmarks/glm53/two-replica"
IMAGE="local/vllm-glm53-flash:sm120-v8"
mkdir -p "$ROOT/logs"

COMMON=(
  --model /model
  --served-model-name glm-5.3-flash-nvfp4
  --tensor-parallel-size 4
  --trust-remote-code
  --max-model-len 1048576
  --max-num-seqs 94
  --max-num-batched-tokens 8192
  --block-size 2304
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3
  --moe-backend marlin
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":4}'
  --tool-call-parser glm47
  --enable-auto-tool-choice
  --reasoning-parser glm45
)
ENV_ARGS=(
  -e VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=3600
  -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
  -e TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
  -e FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1
  -e PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
)

# Preserve unrelated observability containers; replace only model services/LB.
docker rm -f glm53-a glm53-b glm53-lb glm53-vllm >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker stop glm52-vllm >/dev/null 2>&1 || true


docker run -d --name glm53-a --restart unless-stopped \
  --gpus all --network host --ipc=host --shm-size=32g \
  -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 "${ENV_ARGS[@]}" \
  -v "$MODEL_DIR:/model:ro" \
  "$IMAGE" "${COMMON[@]}" --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 \
  > "$ROOT/logs/replica-a-container-id.txt"

docker run -d --name glm53-b --restart unless-stopped \
  --gpus all --network host --ipc=host --shm-size=32g \
  -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4,5,6,7 "${ENV_ARGS[@]}" \
  -v "$MODEL_DIR:/model:ro" \
  "$IMAGE" "${COMMON[@]}" --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8081 \
  > "$ROOT/logs/replica-b-container-id.txt"

echo "Replicas launched. Wait for both /health endpoints before starting HAProxy."
